title: task.create
description: Create a new task, such as collecting diagnostic data or checking items/low-level discovery rules without a config reload. Only available to the Super admin user type.

type.description: Task type. Possible values: 1 - Diagnostic information; 6 - Check now.

request.description: Task request object according to the task type. 'Check now' tasks can only be created for the following types of items/discovery rules: Zabbix agent, SNMPv1/v2/v3 agent, Simple check, Internal check, External check, Database monitor, HTTP agent, IPMI agent, SSH agent, TELNET agent, Calculated check, JMX agent.

proxy_hostid.description: Proxy about which the Diagnostic information task will collect data. Ignored for 'Check now' tasks.

statisticRequest.description: Statistic request object. Used to define what type of information should be collected about server/proxy internal processes.

stats.description: Statistic object properties to be returned. Default: extend will return all available statistic fields.

top.description: Object to sort and limit returned statistic values. Example: { "source.alerts": 10 }.

itemid.description: ID of item or low-level discovery rule.

historycache.description: History cache statistic request. Available on server and proxy.

valuecache.description: Value (items) cache statistic request. Available on server.

preprocessing.description: Preprocessing manager statistic request. Available on server and proxy.

alerting.description: Alert manager statistic request. Available on server.

lld.description: LLD manager statistic request. Available on server.
